ToolSearch.native:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms
ToolSearch.local:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called using DeferredToolCall.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Call deferred tools through DeferredToolCall with {name, input}. Call resident tools directly using their normal tool calls, even if their definitions were returned by direct selection.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block. For deferred tools, parameters describes the input object passed to DeferredToolCall.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

Example (TodoWrite is deferred and already loaded):
<example>
DeferredToolCall({"name":"TodoWrite","input":{"todos":[{"content":"Inspect the implementation","status":"in_progress","priority":"high"}]}})
</example>

DeferredToolCall.native: Immediately call one deferred tool and return its result. Use ToolSearch to load its complete definition, then pass its exact name and input object. Only deferred tools can be called here; call resident tools directly using their normal tool calls.
